plugin.description: Terrain-based leader following with shared WASD and local co-op P2 arrow correction.
local_coop: Local co-op: shared WASD with P2 arrow correction
coop_hint: Select the leader, P1 and P2. WASD moves both players toward the leader; arrow keys must control only P2 through your mapping. {0} starts/stops; Escape stops. Check both phases in preview first.
coop_limits: Correction releases WASD, pauses P1, and routes P2 to P1. Once reunited, arrows are released and shared WASD resumes toward the leader. Distances are in grid cells. Stop before opening controller chat; its state is unavailable.
hint: Select WASD movement in PoE2. {0} starts/stops; Escape stops. Foreground game only. Start in preview mode and inspect the route.
choose_leader: Select the leader from nearby players
no_players: No nearby players detected. Move into the same area as the leader.
clearance_hint: Prefer routes away from walls, but allow closer movement when starting beside a wall or passing through a narrow corridor.
limits: Temporary interruptions release movement and resume automatically. Stalls force short presses toward the current target without terrain filtering. A missing leader or invalid selection stops following; {0} or Escape stops manually. Closed doors still require manual opening; no portal or background input.
status.stopped: Stopped — {0} to start, Escape to stop
status.area_changed: Waiting for the area; characters will be located again automatically
status.settings_open: Settings open — following resumes when closed
status.frame_gap: Rendering resumed — refreshing the route automatically
status.unfocused: Waiting for the game to regain focus; following remains enabled
status.game_state: Waiting for active gameplay; following remains enabled
status.panel: Waiting for chat/panels to close or UI data to recover
status.player_invalid: Waiting for the controlled character to be visible, alive and readable
status.follower_name: Select P2 from the nearby-player list first
status.primary_name: Select P1 from the nearby-player list first
status.secondary_invalid: Waiting for P2 to be visible, alive and readable
status.ambiguous_player: Selected name is ambiguous — check selection, then press {0}
status.same_player: P2 must differ from both P1 and the leader
status.follower_changed: Locating the controlled character again by the selected name
status.leader_name: Select the leader from the nearby-player list first
status.target_missing: Selected leader not found — stopped; press {0} when visible again
status.leader_unavailable: Leader found but dead or unreadable — waiting to resume automatically
status.target_changed: Rechecking characters, area and UI before resuming
status.terrain_missing: Waiting for valid terrain/positions or a shorter navigation distance
status.no_path: No walkable route — check doors and terrain obstacles
status.manual: Manual input ({0}) — resumes when these keys are released
status.recovering: Forcing a short press toward the current target
status.recovery_no_direction: Forced recovery needs a target direction — waiting for position/projection data
status.recovery_wait: Recovery pause — observing movement before retrying/replanning
status.input_failed: Input temporarily failed — releasing keys and retrying
status.error: Error — keys released; retrying shortly; details in settings
status.combat: Skill press / cast pause — following resumes afterwards
combat.title: Combat assistance
combat.hint: Rules run top to bottom while following, including when already near the leader. Conditions within each rule are ANDed. Each action briefly releases movement, presses one key, then resumes following. P2 correction has priority. Preview sends no keys.
combat.aim: Keys use your existing game/controller mapping and current aim. Selecting P1/P2 only changes whose position and status are read; it does not route keys to that player. No automatic aiming or chasing.
combat.scan: Scan selected character's buffs and skills
combat.scan_hint: Scan names are a snapshot, not a live status display. Buff names match a case-insensitive substring; skill readiness uses the exact internal name. Leave optional conditions empty to ignore them. Unknown required data blocks the rule.
combat.name: Rule name
combat.key_conflict: This key is also the start/stop hotkey. The rule is blocked until one binding changes.
combat.intervals: The repeat interval is a local input throttle, not the game's cooldown. At most one key is sent per 300 ms; rules sharing a key share its throttle. Percentages use unreserved life/mana; a missing resource (e.g. no ES) does not satisfy a below-threshold condition.
combat.scan_failed: Selected character's data is unavailable. Check character selection and move into the same area.
combat.status.navigation: Combat waits for P2 correction / unstuck recovery
combat.status.unavailable: Combat waits for readable player data, a combat area and no grace period
combat.status.pressed: Key sent: {0} ({1}); resuming follow after cast pause
combat.status.waiting: Waiting for a matching rule / cooldown
combat.status.idle: Combat idle; requires active following and a selected character
